newsitem.title: USA: Dakotah sees higher Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Dakotah sees higher Q3 results.

text.p: Dakotah Inc said Friday it expects third-quarter earnings per share will exceed the $0.05 earned in the same 1995 period.
It also said sales are expected to be about $12.5 million, up from $8.2 million in the 1995 third quarter.
It said the sales increase is the result of higher sales of pillows and chair pads, bed coverings and the company's Polarfleece line of products, primarily throw pillows and blankets.
Delays in delivery of fabric, especially Polarfleece, held down shipments, it said.

"We believe that if not for these delays and the challenges of getting our new Redfield, S.D., Polarfleece manufacturing facility up to standard, our sales could have reached nearly $14 million," Chief Executive Officer Troy Jones said in a statement.

Jones said gross margin percentages were hurt by costs related to manufacturing start-up expenses, insufficient fabric deliveries in July and August affecting sales and manufacturing efficiencies, and increasing sales of products with a high raw material percentage content.
He also cited certain promotional expenses.

Separately, Dakotah said it had signed a licensing agreement with Disney Enterprises Inc, a Walt Disney Co unit, for its Mickey & Co and Baby Mickey & Co brands. It will introduce a collection featuring Disney characters at a trade show next week in New York City.
